newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open weaker, sterling value limits fall.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open weaker, sterling value limits fall.

text.p: UK shares opened weaker on Wednesday after a heavy wave of profit-taking on Wall Street knocked the Dow down 1.2 percent overnight.
At 0844 GMT, the leading FTSE 100 was down 13.7 points at 4,047.8.
The Dow, up about 10 points when London markets closed, settled at 6,442.69, down 79.01 points.
"We haven't been following Wall Street up ... we have been following it down ... but I don't think it will be a disaster by any means," said one dealer.
